text:
alex: Heads up — multiple customers reporting 504s and long timeouts hitting hosted inference around 12:03 UTC. Spike looks correlated to elevated request queue depth on the ingress gateway. attaching a sample request id: req_3a7f9c
priya: Thanks. Are these p95 drops or full 5xx waves? any tenant pattern?
sam: Quick glance: p95 for that window jumped from 220ms -> 3.2s. Error rate (5xx) from gateway + continuous-batcher timeouts. Tenants mostly small concurrency bursts but one mid-size tenant had a sustained burst from 12:01-12:07.
emily: I see repeated logs indicating dequeue waits and long KV cache miss penalties. snippet from gateway logs:
```
2025-03-15T12:02:58Z WARN ingress gateway queue_depth=980/1024 tenant=acme request_id=req_3a7f9c wait_ms=1200
2025-03-15T12:03:03Z ERROR batcher dequeue_timeout seq_len=1024 batch_wait_ms=1100 tenant=acme
```
maria: sounds like continuous-batcher backlog + high seq_len causing queue saturation. Are we seeing autoscale not keeping up?
sam: Autoscaler did spawn, but it's too slow for the sudden IRR (ingress ramp). The batcher warmup + KV cache spinup added ~700ms per request for some paths.
support-jen: Customer-facing: acme support ticket #T-1129: they see repeated request timeouts and app retries. They want a repro timeline and mitigation.
alex: Can we get an immediate mitigation to reduce customer impact? options: 1) route this tenant to Dedicated fallback pool, 2) reduce max batch size for hosted batcher temporarily, 3) throttle concurrency for the tenant (tenant-level soft cap).
priya: I'll try a live quick patch: reduce batch_max_tokens and batch_max_items by 30% via runtime override for the hosted pool. If it lowers queue hold times, we can keep until load subsides.
emily: Also enabling emergency prefix caching for common short prompts would help, but that needs config push.
sam: Quick repro steps for engineering notes (do not share raw customer data):
- replay captured 5k requests from 12:00-12:08 against staging gateway with same batching config
- ramp to same concurrency pattern (sustained 120 rps with microbursts to 350 rps)
- measure dequeue latency and batcher dequeue timeouts
priya: Doing the patch now. `kubectl patch deployment hosted-batcher -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"runtime/override":"batch_scale_down_30"}}}}}'`
priya: Patch applied. Observing metrics...
(sre-bot): Incident INC-2025-342 created and assigned to eng-runtime on call: @sam @priya
sam: Early telemetry: queue depth dropped from ~980 -> ~620 in ~45s, p95 reduced from 3.2s -> 980ms. 5xx rate trending down.
support-jen: Noted, I told the customer we applied a mitigation and are monitoring. They asked for ETA to full fix.
maria: Root cause hypothesis: sudden tenant burst + long sequences triggered KV misses + continuous-batcher warmup; combined with autoscaler lag, queue depth hit near hard limit causing dequeue timeouts and cascading 504s.
alex: Action items:
- priya: keep the override until traffic stabilizes and post exact timing (done)
- sam: run repro in staging and link traces (by EOD)
- emily: look into faster warmup paths for KV cache + reduce cold start penalty (P0/P1 triage)
- maria: check whether queue depth threshold should be raised or adaptive shedding added for customer-facing tenants
- support-jen: notify customer with next update in 30m
sam: Repro job kicked: `./tools/replay --trace=12-03-spike.json --concurrency=350 --duration=10m` — initial run reproduces increased dequeue waits and batcher timeouts.
priya: Adding an emergency route rule to move acme -> dedicated-pool if latency > 1.5s for 2m. Applying now.
(sre-bot): Routing rule applied: acme -> dedicated-pool (temp)
support-jen: Customer confirms latency reduced after our notification; they reported fewer timeouts 5m after mitigation.
emily: Short-term follow-ups: auto-scale warmup tuning, faster KV preheat on new batches, add rate-limiter with backpressure at ingress to avoid hitting hard queue depth.
maria: Long-term: consider dynamic batch size per tenant, predictive warmup based on traffic shape, and per-tenant circuit breaker with graceful retries + jitter.
alex: Good. Keep this thread updated. Sam/Emily/Maria — please paste final RCA and a runbook change if thresholds need updating.
priya: Logging timestamps for audit: mitigation applied 2025-03-15T12:04:10Z, routing fallback at 2025-03-15T12:05:30Z, observed p95 improvement at 2025-03-15T12:05:55Z.
sam: Will attach staging repro traces and flamegraphs to the incident ticket INC-2025-342.
emily: Also creating a short postmortem checklist to add to runbook: `go/runbooks/ingress-queue-saturation`
support-jen: I'll keep the customer updated; please tag me when RCA is ready so I can send a summary. :thumbsup:
alex: Thanks team. Closing mitigation path but keeping monitoring until next check-in.
